nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 一场午后雨刚刚停下。你和三位伙伴带着各自保存的线索，在新加坡旧禧街警察局前会合。

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Five cities, three flights, and Marcus still insists his photo was the important clue.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Because it was, my man. A picture got us the frequency. That's evidence.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Argue later! The last signal starts at sunset, and Gardens by the Bay is this way. Come on!

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 超级树的灯光亮起时，三份线索同时出现了新的波形。你把它们叠在一起，听见 E.M. 留下的最后一段录音。

nodes.speaker: E.M.
nodes.text: If you can hear this, the map worked. Not because it led you to places—but because it led you to people.

nodes.speaker: Oliver
nodes.text: Agreed. A story locked in a drawer is just very organised silence.

nodes.speaker: Ruby
nodes.text: Yes! The next traveller should hear us and wonder who on earth we were.

nodes.speaker: Marcus
nodes.text: Then let's make it honest. No perfect speech, no posing. Just us, right now.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 你按下录音键。雨后潮湿的风、远处熟食中心的笑声，以及四个人不太整齐的开场白，被保存为地图上的新坐标。

nodes.speaker: 你
nodes.text: To whoever finds this next: every city sounds different when you have someone to listen with.

nodes.speaker: 旁白
nodes.text: 【获得 200 金币】五城主线完成。世界地图上，还有许多没有写下的声音。
